args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west) began failing health checks with an error rate of ~18%. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy release (error rate now ~0.2%). Service is healthy again across all regions. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure not yet identified — needs follow-up investigation before redeploying.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: Confirmed the latest deploy of `checkout-api` (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all production regions with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified**: Service is now healthy in all regions, with error rate back down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: Root cause for v2.3.1's failure hasn't been investigated yet — the incident notes it needs follow-up before redeploying that version.
